ticket.title: Capture short commit ref and respect verifier/summary in VerificationReceipt
ticket.description: Add commit_ref to VerificationReceipt across storypole-core and CONTRACTS.md, auto-populate with short git hash (git rev-parse --short HEAD), and wire CLI and MCP --verifier / --summary arguments into verify_task instead of hardcoding 'manual'.
acceptance_criteria: VerificationReceipt includes optional commit_ref with 7-character git commit hash,storypole verify and storypole_verify MCP respect passed --verifier and --summary arguments,defaults to short HEAD commit when verifying in a git repository

verification_receipt.summary: Completed in storypole upgrade with multi-commit VerificationReceipt and Git branch tracking
